Modal Sizes
Themed Modals (.bg-*)
Basic Modal

This is a basic neo-brutalist modal. It has a standard header, body, and footer. The background overlay obscures the page, and you can close it by clicking outside or pressing Escape.

Vertically Centered Modal

By adding .modal-centered to the .modal-backdrop, this modal appears exactly in the middle of the screen instead of sliding down from the top.

Scrollable Content

When you have a lot of content, the modal will eventually grow taller than the viewport. Adding .modal-scrollable to the backdrop restricts the height and adds an internal scrollbar to the body area.

Static Backdrop

This modal has .modal-static applied to the backdrop. Clicking outside of the modal will not close it, and pressing the Escape key will also be ignored. It plays a shake animation to indicate the user must interact with it directly.

Borderless Modal

Adding .modal-borderless to the backdrop removes the header and footer borders, creating a unified block of content. It also increases the shadow depth slightly for a more prominent floating effect.
